posts.author: beveren
posts.text: «The market remains extremely firm into the end of the week, with tonnage still exceptionally tight and little change in the underlying picture from this week. A few deals have been seen in the AG, with Fujairah/ L. East-S.East levels pushing into the WS550-600. The Atlantic has seen less visible activity, largely due to the lack of available tonnage, although WAF/East has been reported around WS350. With the lists still looking very thin, owners remain firmly in control heading into next week and charterers continue to face very limited options.» Oversatt fra rapport til enkelt å forstå: Dette skal videre opp 🔥 Det er for lite skip tilgjengelig  Eg har også frå truverdig kilde, TC 6-9m for ein VLCC er på subs til usd 250,000 per day.
